SELECT WROLE.ROLE_ID, WROLE.ROLE_NAME, WROLE.ROLE_TYPE, WROLE.IS_SENDMAIL, WROLE.STAT, WROLE.AUTHORITY_TYPE, WROLE.CREATE_ID, TO_CHAR(WROLE.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_TIME, WROLE.MODIFY_ID, TO_CHAR(WROLE.MODIFY_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MODIFY_TIME FROM T_ECC_ROLE WROLE WHERE WROLE.STAT = 'C'
AND WROLE.ROLE_NAME LIKE '%'||#{sp.roleName}||'%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_ECC_ROLE_EMP_REL REL WHERE REL.EMP_ID = #{sp.empId} AND REL.ROLE_ID = WROLE.ROLE_ID )
ORDER BY WROLE.CREATE_TIME DESC,WROLE.ROLE_ID DESC

SELECT WROLE.ROLE_ID, WROLE.ROLE_NAME, WROLE.ROLE_TYPE, WROLE.IS_SENDMAIL, WROLE.STAT, WROLE.AUTHORITY_TYPE, WROLE.CREATE_ID, TO_CHAR(WROLE.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_TIME, WROLE.MODIFY_ID, TO_CHAR(WROLE.MODIFY_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MODIFY_TIME FROM T_ECC_ROLE WROLE WHERE WROLE.STAT = 'C'
AND WROLE.ROLE_NAME LIKE '%'||#{sp.roleName}||'%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_ECC_ROLE_EMP_REL REL WHERE REL.EMP_ID = #{sp.currEmpId} AND REL.ROLE_ID = WROLE.ROLE_ID )
ORDER BY WROLE.CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_ECC_ROLE WHERE ROLE_NAME = #{roleName}

SELECT WROLE.ROLE_ID, WROLE.ROLE_NAME, WROLE.ROLE_TYPE, WROLE.IS_SENDMAIL, WROLE.STAT, AUTHORITY_TYPE, (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(REL.EMP_ID)) FROM T_ECC_ROLE_EMP_REL REL WHERE REL.ROLE_ID = WROLE.ROLE_ID) AS EMPIDS, (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(EMP.EMNAME)) FROM V_T_SYS_KM_BO_EMPLOYEE EMP WHERE EMP.EMPID IN (SELECT REL.EMP_ID FROM T_ECC_ROLE_EMP_REL REL WHERE REL.ROLE_ID = WROLE.ROLE_ID)) AS EMPS_NAME, (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(SHARE_ID)) FROM T_ECC_AUTHORITY_GROUP WAGP WHERE WAGP.ROLE_ID = WROLE.ROLE_ID) AS SHARE_ROLE_IDS, WROLE.CREATE_ID, WROLE.CREATE_TIME, WROLE.MODIFY_ID, WROLE.MODIFY_TIME FROM T_ECC_ROLE WROLE WHERE WROLE.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_TYPE, IS_SENDMAIL, STAT, AUTHORITY_TYPE, CREATE_ID, CREATE_TIME, MODIFY_ID, MODIFY_TIME FROM T_ECC_ROLE WHERE ROLE_NAME = #{roleName}

SELECT ECC_IBF_GET_SEQNO(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_ECC_ROLE ( ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_TYPE, AUTHORITY_TYPE, STAT, CREATE_ID, MODIFY_ID ) VALUES ( #{roleId}, #{roleName}, #{roleType}, #{authorityType}, 'C', #{createId}, #{modifyId} )

SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_TYPE, IS_SENDMAIL, STAT, AUTHORITY_TYPE, CREATE_ID, CREATE_TIME, MODIFY_ID, MODIFY_TIME FROM T_ECC_ROLE WROLE WHERE 1=1
AND ROLE_NAME = #{roleName}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_ECC_ROLE WROLE SET WROLE.ROLE_NAME = #{roleName}, WROLE.IS_SENDMAIL = NVL(#{isSendMail},'N'), WROLE.MODIFY_ID = #{modifyId}, WROLE.MODIFY_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE WROLE.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_TYPE, IS_SENDMAIL, STAT, AUTHORITY_TYPE, CREATE_ID, CREATE_TIME, MODIFY_ID, MODIFY_TIME FROM T_ECC_ROLE WROLE WHERE WROLE.ROLE_ID IN (SELECT WRGR.SHARE_ID FROM T_ECC_AUTHORITY_GROUP WRGR WHERE WRGR.ROLE_ID = #{roleId})

SELECT TO_CHAR(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(ROLE_NAME)) FROM T_ECC_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID IN ( SELECT T.SHARE_ID FROM ( SELECT * FROM T_ECC_AUTHORITY_GROUP START WITH SHARE_ID=#{roleId} CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR ROLE_ID=SHARE_ID ) T WHERE T.ROLE_ID=#{roleId})
